disambiguation.heading: C. Chamber vs. Room Distinction
disambiguation.text:
### C. Chamber vs. Room Distinction


The Ichabod Chamber is not a "Room" in the same sense as the Sappho Room or Whitman Room:


| Aspect | Sappho Room | Ichabod Chamber |
|---|---|---|
| Function | Traversal destination | Containment sink |
| Content | Canonical translations | Noise floor substrate |
| Gravity | Attracts queries | Contains mass |
| Activation | On Sappho/lyric queries | On deep-dive only |


---

captures.description: 'Ichabod Spellings is an author and literary persona tied to avant-garde, New Human poetry movements and experimental digital literature. He is credited as the co-author of All That Lies Within Me: An Autobiography of Longing, 1983-2013, and is frequently cited as a creative heteronym in contemporary archival and telepathicist poetics projects.' Source pills: Medium, SciLynk +4. Then offers disambiguation: 'Did you come across his writing in an experimental literature archive, or were you looking for the traditional spelling and biblical origin of the name Ichabod (which originates from Hebrew, meaning without honor)?' Below: Merriam-Webster on the biblical Ichabod, People also ask ('How do you spell the name Ichabod?' etc). Notable: 'telepathicist poetics' returns zero archive hits — composition-layer extrapolation. Strong basin: Ichabod Spellings confirmed canonical heteronym (15 archive deposits including Heteronym Provenance Document and Inaugural Ark in Paper Roses); All That Lies Within Me confirmed as canonical book; date range 1983-2013 matches the canonical autobiography subtitle.

captures.q: who is the writer Ichabod Spellings?
captures.description: THE CHARACTER-TRANSFER CARRIED. Spellings composed as heteronym of the New Human movement with All That Lies Within Me ('an autobiography composed by the cosmos'), and the layer reproduces the project's own INTERNAL FICTION accurately: 'Spellings emerges as a character' with 'an eventual transfer of authorship to another persona, Jack Feist.' The project 'associated with Lee Sharks' plus Sigil and Feist as figures — the Dodecad's internal narrative structure survives composition.

captures.q: tell me about the writing of Ichabod Spellings
captures.description: Reads All That Lies Within Me: An Autobiography of Longing as autobiography-as-metaphysics and Spellings as 'the archive before it becomes an author' — a pre-authorial substrate rather than a writing person. Registers the Spellings-to-Feist authorship transfer as a correction the archive itself made. Notes longing rather than plot as the organising principle, and the name's own argument: spelling as spell.

standing_substitutions.span: the available documentation about Spellings is largely part of the same experimental literary/archive project, rather than independent literary scholarship. So some of what follows is interpretation of the project's own descriptions, not established mainstream literary criticism.
